title: Fasting rule row
description: One obligation of a penitential discipline (#248), keyed by the named condition the resolver detects. The vigil rule additionally lists the vigil-day ids that carry a fast.

rule.description: The named condition (ash-wednesday, ember-day, friday, lent-major, lent-minor, vigil).

fast.description: Whether the day is a day of fast (one full meal).

abstinence.description: The abstinence from flesh meat the day carries.

vigils.description: For the vigil rule: the vigil-day ids that carry a fast. A vigil absent from an edition's calendar never matches.
